method.host: Windows 11 build 26100 · Ryzen 9 9950X3D · RTX 4090 24 GB · driver 617.42
method.cold: server process launch through receipt of first encoded WAV; on-disk model cache retained
method.warm: median of three requests to the same process through receipt of encoded WAV
method.memory: 200 ms sampling; whole RTX 4090 including desktop; process tree summed RSS; pre-launch GPU reading when recorded. Warm pre-request VRAM is the median of three whole-card readings immediately before warm requests
method.quality: PCM16 RMS and trailing windows below -60 dBFS; these are level and duration checks, not a listening study

groups.YuE2: Text-to-song uses the same style, words, seed and 32 steps. The audio.cpp request fixes 750 semantic tokens. Replay supplies the same 100 semantic tokens and two steps to both engines. Native VAE is F32 and audio.cpp VAE is F16 in both workloads.
groups.ACE-Step 1.5: Same prompt, seed 42, 30 s, eight Euler steps, CFG 1, shift 3 and 110 BPM. The native CUDA take has 5 s quiet at the end; the audio.cpp take has none. Model packing and audible outputs differ.
groups.MiniMax Music3: Same prompt, lyrics, seed 424242, target 3.2 s and two steps. Native Quality and audio.cpp Q8_0 share LM, depth, DiT and conditioning weights, with different vocoders and runtime controls. Native Minimal uses lower quantization.
groups.Stable Audio 3: Same prompt, seed 42, target 4 s and four steps. HOT-Step Medium and audio.cpp Small Music have different model sizes and precision.

method.resident_memory: Windows 11, RTX 4090, driver 617.42, CUDA 13. Median of three idle snapshots of the server process tree after one conditioning request with models kept loaded. WDDM Dedicated Usage is summed across adapters for the tree. RSS is the sum of resident system memory for the tree.
